Among applicants matching the profile (Hispanic or Latino White Female, age 55-64), I found 31 cases in the data. Of these, 27 received loan originations (87.1%) and 4 were denied (12.9%). This approval rate is comparable to or better than the overall dataset approval rate of approximately 88.5%. The denials appear related to high debt-to-income ratios (>60% in 2 cases, 50-60% in 1 case) or other financial factors rather than demographic characteristics. No systematic discrimination pattern is evident against this demographic group.
